'''Sugatis''' were large creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otavon XII]] with characteristics similar to a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] or [[balyeg]]. Their skin was resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attack, but they were just barely smart enough to be influenced by Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]].

During the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the [[Ovoni]] rebels on Otavon XII found a way to attract a Sugati to cause it to attack [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops via a sound emitter, a tactic they used to great effectiveness in the destruction of [[Tremor Base]].
